_design: First visit to the farm: Steve says hello and he names the farm. The farm name is shown on screen; narration never says it, so every line can be pre-recorded.

lines.hello: Hello! I'm Steve. I live on this farm, and I'm going to need your help.
lines.askFarmName: Our farm doesn't have a name yet. What shall we call it? Tap the microphone and say it, or type it.
lines.farmNamed: What a good name for a farm. Now, I need your help…
lines.tryAgain: Say it again, or type it.
